caption:
Chrome can now read your Gmail inbox to fill out online forms using AI. 🤖 It pulls up flight details and tracking numbers automatically. It is super convenient, but also wild how deep tech companies go into our stuff just to save us three seconds of typing. Would you let your browser read your emails for convenience? Let me know below. 👇

@google

Source: TechCrunch, Google Blog, The Verge

#Chrome #GoogleGemini #TechNews #ArtificialIntelligence #ProductivityHacks

post.news: Chrome updated its autofill feature to use Gemini, letting it read your Gmail inbox to suggest flight details and tracking numbers.
post.take: Google reads our emails so we don't have to look for flight tickets. Thanks bestie, totally not creepy.
post.insight: Browser updates are increasingly about lock-in, turning convenience tools into walls that keep users inside the tech ecosystem.
